svg.title: How @subql/common 5.8.3 reached npm, and the control that stops each step
svg.desc: Left column: the publish path on October 5, 2026. A side branch rewrote publish.yml, a workflow_dispatch run on that branch got an OIDC token, npm matched the repository and workflow file name, 5.8.3 was published with provenance, and tilde ranges in other SubQuery packages resolved to it. Right column: the control that blocks each step: an environment limited to main, required reviewers, the environment name on the npm trusted publisher, stage-only publishing with 2FA approval, and lockfiles with a provenance ref check.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
